notes.title: EarthRoyale 3 releasing soon
notes.notes:
if you're interested you can wishlist the game and after the 13th buy it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3106520/EarthRoyale_3/]here[/url]

slight warning, english is my 2nd language and i got dyslexia and i'm just a really ramblying person when i write longer stuff, this is a really long text of me describing the sequel.

I've worked hard most of this year now on the squeal to this game and it's nearing steam release now. while still in early development it is a lot more advanced, better looking and more fun already!

my aim is to make it what i wanted out of this game but couldn't because i was in school and still very new to game development when i started development of earthroyale (1st game started development with me having 2 years of experience with this squeal starting development with me having around 4-5 years)


it's the same chaotic observation game with random generation at the core of the game play but now having each pixel being interactive, 3 map size options (biggest is 8192x4096 pixels big and smallest is 2048x1025 pixels big)
all map sizes have 4 map version of them

Un map (Only un recognized borders and countries)

De facto map (My attempt at adding all countries / organized groups in control of territory with somewhat up to date borders based on who has military control over what area, some areas are a bit out of date or has stuff missing due to me not being informed or because of near daily border changes)

and then both of those 2 have a variant with some micro nations added to them with more micro nations 
most likely being added in the future.

and on top of that there is 2 visual ways of displaying the map in game, globe mode (the way i prefair and the game is mostly developed in) and flat mode (normal flat map)
this causes there to be at this point 4 map sizes, 4 map options, 2 map display options and therefore a total of 16 map options

and while not done yet there is a city map with over 1300+ cities on it, a subdivision map with nearly all countries subdivisions on it but it's still being planned and also ethnicity / culture and sub continent map options but they are not in any form of development yet. all of those will be playable map options later on and most likely also have a similar turn on and off individual countries cities / subdivisions / whatever just like in EarthRoyale

There is also plans to add other planets with most work on the moon already being done (just need to get done with colonizing code and plan out the events leading to the start of moon colonization beforehand)

Right now there is support for fully custom map however decided to require you to use 3rd party painting apps to make them instead of making a in game paintmode again, tutorials are in the works for it but it is really simple.
(unlike in earthroyale, you can make new landmasses and so on to make whatever you want)

this all will hopefully lead to having truly infinite options of maps to play with!



for events there is some big changes, first of all the game is now "semi turn based" there is turns but each turn is real time and real time stuff happens during the turns

there is right now 3 types of events

Turn based (main focus events, usually wars and only allow 1 at a time to help you not miss anything happening)
right now there is 3 + 2 (or more) in development

Divide/all vs 1 war (all countries bordering or nearby a specific country declare war on them and only ends if the attacked country is defeated or a peace treaty is signed)

Referendum Failed / 1v1 war (A country holds a referendum to be annexed by a nearby country but votes no, a war between the 2 countries start and it only ends if it either other nearby country joins the war (converts it to a all vs 1 war) or if one of the 2 countries is fully defeated or if a peace treaty is signed)

Referendum Success / annex (a country holds a referendum to be annexed by a nearby country and votes yes, they get fully annexed within just a few days of time)

i'm also working on civil war based events (similar to the split and independence events in EarthRoyale) and while i'm hoping for them to be done before release there is a possibility it will be released a few days after)


Real time events (secondary events that can happen at the same time as turn based events, event dependent events and other real time events but might not always be super important for you to focus on)
right now there is 3

Flood (water starts spreading onto land from any shore pixel and covers a area with similar height on the height map with water, this water is mostly permanent and will create a new shoreline / creates obstacles for countries to get around when in wars)

Drain Singular (A country starts draining lakes or oceans within a random radius and in similar height level to a selected shoreline pixel, this is permanent and expands the country / creates a new shoreline and makes invading other countries easier)

Drain Shared (Same as Drain singular but each pixel is given to the closest country)


Event Dependent events (Events that can only happen while a specific event is happening)
right now there is 2

Naval invasion (a random pixel is selected on a country's shore line and it looks for the easiest place to invade, can only happen during wars and if at least 1 country on each side has a shoreline)

Peace treaty (Happens if a war has been going on for too long or if there is a stalemate, attempts to clean up the border and remove most exclaves and encirclement created by the war and ends the conflict)

on top of all this the end of each event isn't determined emedietly anymore and the visual changes of events isn't just a glorified loading screen and are instead actual invasions happening with constant changes that might change the outcomes

a lot of hard work has gone into this and i got a lot of big plans already in the works and soon in the works so a really hope you're as excited as me for the future!

notes.title: Temp fix for save issue (soon ish bug patch fixing it completly)
notes.notes:
I found the issue with saves today (been really busy with irl stuff and working on new game so took time to find time to do it)
It's that the antarctica treaty numbers in the save file includes decimals and then the game tries to convert it to a variable that can't handle decimals, causing a error and therefore stops the rest of the save being loaded in and the map from refreshing.

to fix it, simply go to the folder users/(your pc user name)/appdata/locallow/dafaultcompany/earthroyale

then choose what type of save to fix (Scenario,Paintmode or just saves) then choose the save, then go into the Antarcticatreaty text file and remove all decimal numbers (the game requires there to still be 4 numbers in there with a % dividing them, just no decimals).

after next bug patch that part of the save file will support having decimals and therefore all old save files will work again, this is just a quick temp fix to make your saves work now

notes.title: V14 & Antarctica DLC Info
notes.notes:
First of, if you want to watch everything new in the update before the release, there will be a showcase stream [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wubXHGhhK60]here [/url]on the 13th / 1 day before the update and DLC release

V14 Brings a lot of visual changes to the game like oceans no longer being a big flat colour and instead having a texture that slowly moves, fire and the new province type lava having smoke over it, 

There is a new updated map for the native reservoirs within USA to be accurate to their actual shape and one new reservoir added (it had the super cute name "rosebud" so i had to add it).
and like 3 small southern island has been moved to antarctica and is no longer in the base game (this should have nearly no effect on people who don't get the DLC and only makes sense as they are a part of the Antarctic continent)

There is also a new world border as while working on the update I got annoyed at how the oceans are infinite, this world border will be togglable however incase you preferer the infinite ocean look.

and i think the biggest most energy draining visual change, new text placement code.
the game will now auto generate areas to place the text within instead of using 1 per country per sub continent, so now each country will have 1 text per area where all provinces border each other.

There has been 4 new events added and 1 event that has gained 3 (5 with the DLC) new variants of it

The first event added is "fortification" this event makes a country fortify a random notable site, this can be  a city, world wonder or nuclear site. however the game will always pick the country's capital if it isn't already fortified and will favor cities.
after a province is fortified it will stop the province from changing hands 1, no matter what way it changes owner, Annexation, split, union, natural disaster, everything but the fortified status is removed immediately after it has been used.

the 2nd new event is "Volcanic Eruption" there has been 20 (23 if you own the DLC) Volcanoes added to the game map, each one with their own size/strength, if a country owns a volcano it will give a slight score boost, but if the eruption event happens the volcano will start spreading lava in multiple directions (depends on volcano size and location how many directions) creating a spider web ish pattern of lava, the lava then will each turn have a high chance of lighting 1 or more provinces around it on fire, but the lava will disappear after a while.

the 3rd and 4th event are sorta connected

the 3rd is "advanced robotics" this event will give a random country a prestige boost if their city is selected, that city will then get the status of having advanced robotics, any city in a country with a minimum of 1 city with advanced robotics will automatically gain the status a well.

and the 4th event is "robot uprising" this event selects a random city with the advanced robotics status and creates a new randomly generated Robot or AI nation, it can however only happen to countries with more than one city

and then the changed event is hurricane, if a hurricane goes over Fire, Flooded or lava province the hurricane will pick it up, changes it's colour and start spreading that province type, there is 2 more province types that this can happen to that will be mention in the DLC section of the post.

and lastly there has been 4 new camera movement buttons added
Q and E now rotates the camera and R and F now tilts the camera, though I do recommend not using it too much, just a fun quick thing I added

the zoom speed has also been changed to be slower the more zoomed in you are and the area the camera can be in and start location of camera has changed slightly


And then the big thing, AntarcticaRoyale,

This DLC adds the entire continent of Antarctica to the game
with multiple starting settings (claims, unclaimed, snow, glacier, research bases and off)

and with that there's also 2 new province types, "Snow" which slowly turns into floods over time as it melts and "Glacier" which is un destructible (sorta) and creates snow around it over time,
there is a lot of glaciers in antarctica at start but it can also be found in Alaska, Greenland and Siberia

There is a new "status" for the entire game called "Antarctica treaty" It's a treaty that creates a few randomized negative score effects on any country claiming antarctica, 1 for having any land there, 1 for each new claim made, and 1 for any old claim pre signing

there is 5 new events in the dlc (6 if you count a secrete one that has sadly been delayed to a few days after release) and 2 new variants to the hurricane event

first of the hurricane event just like mentioned in the v14 section of the post, will now start spreading a few select province type if it goes over one, both glacier and snow can be "picked up" by the hurricanes.

first 2 events added is kinda boring but has a huge impact on the game
first one is "dissolve antarctica treaty", it completely removes all negative score impacts from the treaty making any country with big claims on antarctica over powered.

the 2nd one is "new Antarctic treaty" this event creates a new treaty with new randomized penalties and can give a huge nerf to any Antarctic nations

the 3rd new event is "snow storm" it creates a big chunk of snow on the map with a low chance of the center being turned into glaciers, it also creates a cloud over it that will fade away within 7 seconds, the event can also only happen in the north and south of the map

the 4th event is "melting glacier" this is the only way to get rid of glaciers and it turns all glaciers and snow within a small area instantly into floods

the 5th and last event is "research  base" this allows a country to turn any unclaimed or snow province in antarctica into a new claim, and unlike the colony event, this doesn't need to be a coastal province

and lastly there is a "6th" secrete event that was and is still planned that i sadly didn't have time to finish before the release date and will work on adding into the DLC in a update a few days after release, it's a short super rare "story" of multiple events

also as mentioned in the V14 section the DLC adds 3 volcanoes on the continent

hope you will enjoy all the new content to the game both if you get the DLC or not <3

notes.title: How to Fix V12.02.00 Saves
notes.notes:
after searching for way too long i found the issue with the save files and sadly it means that if you want any saves from V12.02 to function,

you need to manually go to the save file location and either remove the 4 text files for "Islands, NuclearSites, Coast, Capitals" and edit the internal version back to "v120000 "From "v120200"

or Empty the Coast and Island text file (not remove the entire file, just leave it a empty text file)

this is due to me accidentally making them save down the reference to the list of all province IDs instead of the individual IDs that those values effected.

I don't own a [b]linux[/b] so i sadly don't know the path to the save files for linux users, if any smart linux person  knows please write a comment describing the path and i will update this to include the path ^^

[b]for windows[/b] you want to write %appdata% in the file path, then you wanna go back one folder to the folder called just appdata
then enter the folder called local low, then default company, then EarthRoyale.
in earthroyale you will see 1-3 folders depending on the save types you've used, "Scenarios" "PaintMode" and "Saves", you will find all your saves there!

[i](My mac is in Swedish so i will directly translate the button names to english, so it might be slightly differently named

also in the path you write into the go to file, user should be in your computers language and username should be replaced by your profile name on the mac itself!)[/i]

[b]for Mac[/b] you want to enter finder, click go on the top bar, click go to file/folder
write "/user/UserName/Library/Application Support/"
from there you want to go to default company, earthroyale.
in earthroyale you will see 1-3 folders depending on the save types you've used, "Scenarios" "PaintMode" and "Saves", you will find all your saves there!

The Island needs to be smaller than 50x50 pixels.

It needs to be pixel art.

You need to mention how many provinces/Where provinces ends/begins if needed.

You need to mention what classification the island would be within:
Tiny = 1 province.
Small = 2-3 provinces.
Big = more than 3 provinces.
Luxury = Any size but super rare.

The island needs to have a clear black border that's 1pixel thick with a white inside just like how the in game map is, with the outside in any other colour to make it noticeable what is land and ocean

It can be 1 island or a archipelago / island chain, up to you.

The island can't look like any offensive or sexual symbols or objects.

notes.title: V12 SneakPeaks + Event vote Winners
notes.notes:
So as the V12 Event vote is over and the update is closing in i thought i'd do a big sneak peak thread of all major things in v12

First of the 3 biggest things that are not added yet, the 3 winners of the vote:

Singular Expand: A random country will be chosen, and it will expand into one of it's closest Neighbours, this will make normal expand more rare but most likely be more common that the normal expand is now

Change in government: The country renames itself and moves it capital to the biggest "entity" within it's border, could be culture, former country, sub division or even city if that somehow happens

Artificial Islands. A Country will Decide to make a new islands somewhere a long it's coast where it will be placed as far away from any nearby province as possible.

Then there will also be a big visual change, Texts.
it will be togglable as it might cause lag for some players.
How it will work is that each country will gain 1 text for each sub continent they are in, and the text will be placed in between the 2 furthest away provinces they control in that sub continent and rotated based on the differences between those 2 provinces y and x distances
there has been some changes to the sub continents to make the text more visually appealing, like changing England, Wales and Ireland to northern Europe from western Europe to stop the text there to merge with Gibraltar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/a8bc58d5ccd28144b33ed23bcc9ed472aea01789.png[/img]

Then the Main theme/ new thing about the update, World Wars.
the world war will be considered a "chain event" meaning that when it starts, it will unlock 8 new events that can happen related to the world war, and once the world war ends those 8 won't be able to happen anymore.

As the world war starts it will divide the world into 2 or more alliances with randomized names based on what cities, regions or continents are within it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/a49fb66c75ddca218fe20202fd496e3cb14d4bbb.png[/img]
While it doesn't in this image, it will say exactly what world war it is, and let you edit what the first world war number should be in paint mode.

it will also show all alliances in the leaderboard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/e0f805dacb887b62bbdd58be8b35de5d63875831.png[/img]

The alliances also means that most older events have been updated to respect allied nations borders if there is a world war going on.

there 8 new events of the world war

Join alliance: A neutral nation decided to join one of the alliances.

Leave Alliance: A nation left their alliance to become neutral.

Change Alliance: A nation left their alliance to join another alliance.

Joining Ultimatum: an alliance pressures 3 neutral nations near the alliance to join them or be invaded. each of the 3 nations have 2-3 outcomes, 1 they join, 2 they get invaded but keep some land, 3 they get invaded and gets completely annexed.

Moved front: The borders a long the front lines changes slightly based on how many enemy provinces surrounds it + a bit of luck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/3225f239e548a90fb6b68b4eafb791bb5c9d5503.png[/img]

Missile strike: A alliance or country sends missile onto the enemy alliance, making some random provinces turn into wasteland
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/53ae38c34d9efa8da88c95d9f4f9e43a3edc469c.png[/img]

Alliance Expand: an alliance expands into the other alliances
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/7c6a6491a1d33a53992847137aca2b2a0dbbe2eb.png[/img]

And lastly, Peace treaty: the alliances decides to sign a peace treaty, either from there only being 1 left or due to wanting to end the war
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/ffa64379cb12a3c43339105ccb560cfbe381f7cd.png[/img]

There is also some other changes like randomized map, where all provinces, cities, cultures and countries gets randomly placed on the map, with all but cities having random sizes, shapes and positions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/5d50b185378df62b384c615df331f38137ff7667.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/88fb20a432459053668f6df98d491cc22f839f42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/6f6cf4fc46ae8fba097a1954a7d88d60683d40cc.png[/img]

There's also been a big change to how nukes work, now only countries who have a nuclear facility within it's borders got access to nuking other countries, the map starts out with a few within countries with nukes in real life (USA, UK, France, PRC, Russia, Israel, Pakistan, India, North Korea) But anyone can gain access to nukes by either taking over their provinces with nuclear facilities or making their own, and they can all disappears from having nuclear reactor failures happen there
Nukes now can also only happen within roughly 1 5th of the map from a nuclear facility.

There's been some smaller changes like how much you can zoom in and out, limits on annex event sizes.

lastly there are some events stuff that might maybe be delayed to another update or not, depending on how much time i got before the deadline of sometime early December:

God mode, let's you chose what event that should happen and what province / countries it should effect.
Take subdivision / culture: a country forcefully take over an entire culture or sub division within a neighbouring country
Worldwide & Local stats: pages where you can se how many times each country has won for you and worldwide, and also how many times different events have happened.
In game stats: a menu you can open to get specific stats in game for each country like how much coast they got, how many nuclear facilities they got and more!
Unfair Division: division event but doesn't create a equal split between countries

notes.title: v11 Sneak peak + Event vote winners
notes.notes:
Before i show some of the new features and explain how much work is left, i wanna "Announce" the winners of the event vote for everyone that isn't in the discord and already know.

The winners was Partitioned and Culture Union, What they do will be described further down this post but i promise that they are amazing.
also the 8 losing events will re appear again in a new event vote together with some new ones for the next update when the development for it has started :3

Also if you got any suggestions or ideas for the game, you can leave it either in the steam community for it or in the games discord server, as i try to look at most things posted for the game to find bugs needing to be fixed or ideas i might not have thought about!

So first of is the main big feature of the update, that the name "the Scenario Update" comes from, [b]a new and improved paint mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/dd6bd36428e8c2a5622776bad4bc7b1d2833b506.png[/img]

first of, the new PaintMode is completely separated from the normal base game, this is to be able to get rid of some of the technical issues that the old paint mode had such as not having the map update live.

also, this paint mode has 2 new ways to paint.
First of those is the 9 different "Brush" Sizes, with the 1st one being the old 1 province at a time brush and the and 9th being a massive Europe ish sized area.

The 2nd way to paint is to paint an entire "Region", or an entire country, culture, city, sub division or whatever the map is currently showing. this will help if you wanna make for example Sweden-Norway, all you need to do is write in the name and then click both countries once. but if you do that you can also now make the game recognize it as an actual union that can split into 2 countries by filling in the "union member tags" for the country.

as you might have seen in the image it also comes with being able to do custom starting year and month and custom event odds and the possibility of changing what map mode you see the game in

as in you can change to only seeing cultures, or sub divisions, or the 3 easter egg values or union members or cities or the confusingly named country and controller, with controller being the existing country at the start of the game and country being the country that can gain independence as the game goes on.

also while i've not started work on it yet, the paint mode will hopefully come with [b]steam workshop support[/b] on the updates launch. i've never set up workshop for a game before so i don't know how to set it up and it might lead to workshop coming a bit later than the main update or it being connected in a wonky way at first.

and due to all of this, the saves menu has been split into 3, one for save games, one for scenarios downloaded from the workshop and one for paint mode saves. with all 3 now supporting custom names and from what i know infinite save files, but i wouldn't recommend having millions of saves

And on the same lines as workshop, i also wanna try to add a few achievements for now, roughly one per event and rare event type. with plans to make one per easter egg nation and making their independence menu in the main menu need you to unlock their achievements. but that will be done later on

Next up is, drum roll please. [b]new in game ui[/b], that hopefully won't be confusing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/890296bd69767d067d25d4ca4da90f92c486a91d.png[/img]

This new ui keeps the auto camera button but moves it to the top left and shortening it to AC, it also adds a new Auto Play button, but space will still work for turning it on, on the top right you can see 2 new buttons, the top one opens up the pause menu where stuff like main menu, exit game and save game has been moved to. and under the pause button there is a leaderboard button.

in the top middle you can see that the event text box has been made bigger since due to the union names and split names, and events like referendum, the old event text box just didn't work and made a lot of events end up taking up 2-4 rows.
Also the time box has been moved to be in a 2nd row of the top bar in the middle, the ready/calculating text has been moved to the bottom middle and the rest of the bottom bar as been removed.

and now for the most fun part of the new game in my opinion, the [b]4 new events[/b] and the 4 new secrete events

first of we got the 2 new sub events within the border changes category

First one being [b]Take islands[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/0b8fa49729f2f11837c0f27e2764b4810d83459b.png[/img]

In this one country takes all or a few island provinces from the closest country with island. they do not need to take the entire island, they might just take a few provinces. right now all landmasses are considered island except the mainland for each continent with Australia being the mainland for oceania. BUT i'm considering removing the island status from some bigger islands such as Borneo, Greenland and Great Britain 

And the next one is [b]Take Coast[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/e68336a4ee7ab3e1cb50d1f83413994392e1713c.png[/img]

This one is the exact same as the previous one but this time with coastal provinces instead of island provinces, the game considers all provinces along a ocean (not lake or Caspian sea) as coastal

ok next up is [b]the 2 Event vote winners[/b] that both ended up being sub events within the take over category.

[b]culture unions[/b] have not been made or started work yet, but the way it will work is that it will force all countries that originates from within the area of a culture unions (for example "Germanic Union" or "Scandinavian union" or "Central American union" to be forced to join it, but i will most likely make the unions have more fun names such as the Kalmar Union. this does mean however that some easter eggs might be removed as there will now be a culture union with that name.

you will also be able to draw your own culture unions in paint mode or turn on all culture unions at starts similar to how cities and cultures is right now.

and lastly the big [b]partition event[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497537/bcf1d44dc63a8346df7972feef597f9f397f0138.png[/img]

This one is really hard to explain, but what i aimed at with this one is to handle the country simIlar to what Austria Hungary experienced after ww1 and Germany after ww2.

so first of, if it's a union the union members will gain independence, but as small as possible with it still seeming fair (most of the time their culture size or their start of game size)

after that, it will look if any existing country got land within the country that belongs to them and gives it to them.

after that it will give up to 15 countries, cultures, cities or sub divisions independence from it.

and after that it will give up to 10 countries above 50 provinces 1 or more provinces within the country, with countries above 200 provinces being prioritized.

and lastly it will then divide all other provinces between the closest other countries, the newly independent countries and the big nations that gained small areas within it.

as you might have noticed, this event is clearly meant for big countries and not small ones. so it can only happen to countries with more than 150 provinces and will hopefully help with stopping some countries taking over half of the world with all other ones still being small.

I really hope your as exited for v11 as i am, right now it looks like the update will be released within 1-2 weeks of this post with the only things left to add being:

[*] Help menu to explain paint mode, the events and other things that might be needed to explain.
[/list]
